posts.text:
Sunday, Nov 15: Toronto's streetcars lost 785 hours to delays, across all routes.

Slowest for its length: 510 Spadina southbound. A typical 4.9 km trip lost 11 min (usually 11).
Smoothest: 507 Long Branch eastbound, 9 min over 7.8 km (usually 12).

#TTC #TransitSky #DataViz

https://stuckin.to/

Sunday's slowest spot: Southbound on Spadina Ave, approaching Queen St West.
The average streetcar lost 1 min 56 s here (usually 1 min 41 s). Across 207 trips, that adds up to 6.7 hours.
This signal has transit priority.
posts.alt: 3D map of Spadina Ave around Queen St West, rotated to Toronto's street grid. Delay is drawn as a coloured ridge above the track, rising where streetcars lose time; the southbound stretch at Queen St West is highlighted, peaking at about 1 min 56 s lost per streetcar.

shot.title: Spadina Ave southbound, approaching Queen St West
shot.sub: Sunday, Nov 15: 1 min 56 s lost per streetcar · 207 trips

posts.text:
Most short-turned, Sunday, Nov 15: 506 Carlton. 1 in 11 trips (27) were sent back before the end of the line, most after Gerrard St East at Coxwell Ave (eastbound, 13), instead of going on to Main Street Station.

Across all routes, 4% of trips were short-turned.
posts.alt: Map of the 506 Carlton route in the waits view: a column at each stop, taller and darker where riders waited longer than scheduled, and yellow warning signs where cars were short-turned. A tooltip on the busiest spot, after Gerrard St East at Coxwell Ave, gives how many eastbound cars were sent back there instead of going on to Main Street Station.

posts.text:
Most held at a signal, Sunday, Nov 15: westbound at Strachan Ave & Fleet St.

44% of streetcars waited 90 s or more beyond a clean approach, about a full signal cycle, despite transit priority.
About 271 streetcars came through.
posts.alt: Map of the streets around Strachan Ave & Fleet St, with arrows for each direction of streetcar travel into each signal, coloured by how often streetcars were held 90 seconds or more. A tooltip for the westbound approach reads 44% held 90 s+, with a histogram of extra time through the approach.

posts.text:
Sunday, Nov 15: at the busiest moment (1:50 pm), 140 streetcars were in service, against 140 scheduled.
Overall, 99% of scheduled streetcar service ran, and buses ran 772 hours on streetcar routes.
posts.alt: Line chart of streetcars in service through Sunday, Nov 15, every 10 minutes from 4 am, against the TTC's schedule (dashed). The busiest moment was 140 streetcars at 1:50 pm, against 140 scheduled; over the day 99% of scheduled streetcar hours ran.

posts.text:
Longest extra wait at a stop, Sunday, Nov 15: Coxwell Ave at Gerrard St East (506 Carlton eastbound).

Riders waited 17.4 min on average, against 4.9 if cars had come as scheduled: 12.5 min extra. 23% of cars came bunched, and 30 of 131 scheduled cars never came.
posts.alt: Map of the streets around Coxwell Ave at Gerrard St East in the waits view, a column at each stop. A tooltip for the stop reads 12.5 minutes of excess wait, with how often cars came bunched or with gaps, and a chart of the spread of gaps between cars.
